request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: The verifications covered by the IGEA technical sheet are periodic verifications after the first one: under the Ministerial Decree of 11 April 2011, which body is in charge of them and within how many days from the request must they be carried out?

response.text: {"kind": "text", "value": "The ASL (Aziende Sanitarie Locali) are in charge of the periodic verifications after the first one, and must carry them out within 30 days of the request.", "text": "Under art. 2, c. 1 of the Decreto Ministeriale 11 aprile 2011 (DM2011), the ASL are responsible for the verifications periodiche successive alla prima, to be carried out within trenta giorni dalla richiesta; the INAIL handles the first verification, within sixty days. The IGEA technical sheet (igea-equipment.md, pp. 3–4) covers these post-first verifications and refers to the DM 11 aprile 2011 for their methods.", "sources": [{"file": "DM2011.md", "place": "art. 2, c. 1", "quote": "le ASL sono titolari delle verifiche periodiche successive alla prima, da effettuarsi nel termine di trenta giorni dalla richiesta."}, {"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "p. 3, 1. OGGETTO DELLA FORNITURA", "quote": "La presente Scheda Tecnica disciplina, in materia di aspetti tecnici, la verifica periodica (successiva alla prima) degli apparecchi di sollevamento di Igea S.p.A. ... e con le modalità del D.M. 11 aprile 2011"}]}
